The user wants to retrieve a list of resolutions for IP 67.89.0.1 on VirusTotal using API key 'sec_key5' and need the first 25 records. This is a request to call the VirusTotal API. The user specifically says "Help me retrieve a list of resolutions for IP 67.89.0.1 on VirusTotal. I'll use the API key 'sec_key5' and need the first 25 records." They want to retrieve the list of resolutions. That means we need to call the VirusTotal API endpoint for IP address resolution. According to VirusTotal API v3, the endpoint is GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/resolutions. We need to pass the API key in the header. The user wants the first 25 records. The API supports pagination with 'limit' parameter. So we can call GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/67.89.0.1/resolutions?limit=25. We need to provide the API key in the header: "x-apikey: sec_key5". Then we need to parse the JSON response. The user wants the list of resolutions. The response will contain data array with objects containing attributes like domain, last_resolved, etc. We need to extract the domain names and maybe the last resolved timestamp. The user didn't specify what exactly they want from the list. They just said "list of resolutions". So we can provide the domain names and last resolved timestamps. The user might want the entire JSON. But we can provide a summary.

We need to call the API. The user gave us the API key. We can call the API. Let's do it.
